summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Alfred AI travel assistant (frontend-only, scripted responses). Tested initial load, header elements, intro chips, inspire flow with destination carousel, save/drawer flow, destination selection -> duration chips -> itinerary summary -> editor modal with day tabs/stop rows/Add More/Add Day, new-chat reset, location dropdown, free text chat, thumbs-up feedback toast, and responsiveness at 390px & 1280px. All 46 assertions passed across 3 automation runs.

issues: No semantic <main> landmark element - chat container uses divs only. Not blocking but accessibility/SEO improvement.
Kerala Save/Share buttons partially clipped on the right edge of the chat column at desktop widths (visible in screenshots). Consider tighter card sizing or padding.

action_items: Minor: consider wrapping chat area in <main> tag for a11y
Minor: ensure last carousel card (Kerala) is not clipped on desktop 1280px viewport
critical_code_review_comments: Saved drawer close on Escape key not wired - only close button + backdrop click. Acceptable but common UX expectation.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes as required - good coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows pass. Note: destination card selection triggers a subsequent 'duration chips' message with ~2-3s delay. When testing sequential flows, close SavedTripsDrawer via [data-testid=saved-drawer-close-button] (Escape key does NOT close it). No <main> element - chat column layout is div-based.
